headline: Transfer rumors, news: Arsenal, Chelsea, Liverpool to battle for Scott signature
description: Arsenal will challenge Chelsea and Liverpool for the signing of AFC Bournemouth midfielder Alex Scott. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Nicol: Manchester United showing Carrick no respect over Pochettino talks
description: Nicol: Manchester United showing Carrick no respect over Pochettino talks

headline: Sources: Man United contact U.S. Soccer over Poch; Carrick meeting Thursday
description: Manchester United have made contact with U.S. Soccer ahead of triggering Mauricio Pochettino's $10 million release clause as they close on a deal to hire the USMNT manager to replace Michael Carrick, sources told ESPN.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Bayern to sign Liverpool teenager Ngumoha?
description: Bayern Munich are looking to add reinforcements to their attack by signing Liverpool winger Rio Ngumoha. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Schmeichel blasts Man United's 'disrespectful' treatment of Carrick amid Pochettino links
description: Peter Schmeichel has criticised Manchester United for their "disrespectful" treatment of Michael Carrick as the club continue to be linked with Mauricio Pochettino.

headline: Arsenal's Martin Zubimendi denies wanting to leave amid Atlético Madrid links
description: Martín Zubimendi has denied he is considering leaving Arsenal in the January transfer window amid reported interest from Atlético Madrid.
